sql:
SELECT co.name AS empresa, c.name AS campanha, c.status, to_char(c.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS criada,
  c.total_recipients AS total, c.sent_count AS enviados, c.error_count AS erros, c.delay_seconds AS intervalo_s,
  jsonb_array_length(coalesce(c.message_variations, '[]'::jsonb)) AS variacoes, (c.image_url IS NOT NULL) AS tem_imagem,
  c.pause_bot_on_reply AS pausa_bot, (c.auto_reply_message IS NOT NULL AND c.auto_reply_message <> '') AS tem_auto_resposta,
  c.scheduled_at IS NOT NULL AS agendada,
  (SELECT string_agg(r.status || ':' || r.n, ' ' ORDER BY r.status) FROM (SELECT cr.status, count(*) AS n FROM campaign_recipients cr WHERE cr.campaign_id = c.id GROUP BY 1) r) AS destinatarios,
  to_char(c.started_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo', 'MM-DD HH24:MI') AS inicio, to_char(c.completed_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo', 'MM-DD HH24:MI') AS fim
FROM campaigns c JOIN companies co ON co.id = c.company_id
ORDER BY c.created_at DESC
LIMIT 40
